record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Maple Research is the secure workspace for AI that works on your real life. Plan a trip, draft a sensitive document, navigate a legal moment, get a second read on a diagnosis. Every conversation is encrypted with a key known only to your device and our secure enclave. Outside that enclave, your data stays encrypted.

Maple Research runs powerful open weight models inside Trusted Execution Environments. You get the speed and intelligence of cloud AI with the privacy of running your own. Long-form chat, document analysis, image analysis, voice, and live web search, all in one encrypted space.

WHY MAPLE RESEARCH
 • End-to-End Encryption: Your messages are encrypted on your device. Outside the enclave, your data is stored as encrypted blobs only your key can open.
 • Cloud-scale, phone-friendly: Run frontier-grade open weight models without draining your battery.
 • Sync across devices: Start on your iPhone, finish on your Mac. Your encrypted history travels with you.
 • Live Web Search: Real-time, ad-free results powered by Brave. Your queries stay private.
 • Maple API Proxy: Plug your AI agent workflows into encrypted infrastructure. Compatible with OpenCode, goose, and any OpenAI-compatible client.

OPEN WEIGHT MODELS The best open intelligence available, optimized for privacy and speed.
 • Kimi K2.6: Top-tier reasoning, logic, and code.
 • DeepSeek V4: Top-tier reasoning, logic, and code.
 • GPT-OSS 120B: Open reasoning from OpenAI's open release.
 • GLM 5.1: Strong multilingual generalist.
 • Llama 3.1: Capable everyday assistant.
 • Gemma 4: Multimodal. Snap a photo and ask questions about what you see.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
 • Legal & Finance: Analyze contracts, plan finances, prep for tax season. Sensitive details stay encrypted.
 • Health Research: Organize health notes and explore options privately.
 • Voice Mode: Talk to Maple for fast, natural input.
 • Travel Translator: Speak in foreign languages with confidential, real-time translation.
 • Personal Journal: A private space to think out loud and process the day.

TRANSPARENT SECURITY
 • Open-source server code, reproducible builds, and cryptographic attestation you can verify.
 • Trusted Execution Environments process your data inside attested hardware.
 • Your data is not used to train any model.
 • Free tier available. Make an account and start working in seconds.

COMING SOON: MAPLE AGENT The personal AI companion that gets to know you. Long-term memory inside the same encrypted vault. If you can text, you can use Maple Agent. Built on the Maple platform that powers Research.

Download Maple Research and get the AI that respects your privacy.

record.description_evidence:
MarginNote is the PDF study tool for deep readers. One excerpt is a PDF highlight, a mind map node, and a flashcard — one capture, three places. This is the Card Axis architecture, so you stop ferrying content between a PDF reader, a notes app, and a flashcard tool. A decade of iteration. 188K+ App Store ratings.

【Four Featured Mechanics】

▸ Card Axis — One excerpt, three renders. Document highlight, mind map node, and flashcard are the same card seen from three angles.
▸ Title Link — Old notes auto-surface in new documents. When a familiar concept appears in what you're reading, your past annotation lights up on the page.
▸ Extended Note — Long-press anywhere on a PDF to open writing space. No anchored text required; three display modes (inline / margin / collapsed).
▸ Immersive Mode (4.4) — Three-state toggle: Read / Write / Recall. UI folds away. Recall blurs excerpts with Gaussian blur — tap to reveal only after you've actually recalled.

【AI Capabilities (introduced in 4.2)】

AI book breakdown · AI OCR templates · AI translation · AI Q&A · AI flashcard generation
Our stance is AI as assistant, not replacement — every suggestion can be saved as your own thinking node, never thinking for you.

【Apple Intelligence (iOS 26+)】

Recall Mode hints can run on-device via Apple Intelligence — pick "Apple AI" or "cloud LLM" in Settings. With Apple AI selected, three tiers of help — Neighbor Coordinate · Reasoning Prompt · Key Distinction — are generated by Apple Foundation Models right on your device: no network calls, no AI credits used, your notes never leave your device. Even if you've selected cloud LLM, going offline auto-falls back to Apple Intelligence (provided your device supports it) — so libraries, planes, and exam-day silent rooms never break your hint loop.

【Full Workflow】

Fast OCR · Study Sets (PDF / EPUB / video / audio) · direct read from Zotero / cloud drives / USB · 10 mind map styles · book recomposition · dual-document compare · concept maps · handwriting layers

【FSRS Spaced Repetition】

Built on the open-spaced-repetition project's algorithm (paper accepted by ACM SIGKDD; Anki has used FSRS as its default scheduler since v23.10). Push short-term memory into long-term.

【Built For】

Anyone re-reading a single document until it sticks — med school (USMLE / MCAT) · law school (LSAT / bar exam) · grad prep (GRE / GMAT / CFA) · researchers · language learners (IELTS / TOEFL) · serious readers.

【All Apple Platforms】

iPhone + iPad + Mac under one Apple ID. iCloud syncs Study Sets, notes, and review progress. Native Apple Pencil support on iPad.

Muze is a personal agent for errands that take more than one step. Tell it what you need in plain words, then put your phone away. Muze keeps working in the background and lets you know when it needs you.

RESEARCH THAT SHOWS ITS WORK
Compare venues, products, or options. Muze reads the web, organizes what it finds into reports and tables, and links every source. It tells you what it couldn't verify. Export any report as a PDF.

SET IT ONCE
Have Muze check something every morning, on weekdays, or every few hours, and hear from it only when something changes. Ask for a reminder in plain words, like "remind me Friday at 5 to call Mom," and it pings you right on time.

PLACES, ROUTES, AND WEATHER
Ask what's open near you, how long the drive takes, what the weekend forecast looks like, or which flights fit your dates. If you allow location, Muze uses your approximate location only for questions about places nearby.

WORKS WITH YOUR APPS
Connect Notion, Todoist, Linear, Jira and Confluence, Canva, or Calendly in Me → Connected apps. Muze looks things up there on its own, and asks you before it adds or changes anything.

REMEMBERS WHAT MATTERS
Tell Muze your city, your diet, or how you like results, and it uses that in every chat and task. See, edit, or turn off memory anytime in Me.

YOUR OWN MUZE ADDRESS
Pick a username and get a matching email address. Muze can draft emails from it and wait for replies, for days if needed, then pick the task back up when the answer arrives.

YOU DECIDE WHO HEARS FROM YOU
Muze only writes to people you've allowed. Ask it to email someone on your list and it just sends; anyone else, you review, edit, and approve each message first.

FILES, HANDLED
Attach a file and ask Muze to convert it, pull out the data, or turn it into something new. Results land in your Library, ready to open or share.

CALM BY DESIGN
See what's waiting for you, what's in progress, what's scheduled, and what's done. Chats, tasks, and Library items stay until you delete them; files clear after 30 days unless you keep them.

Muze uses AI and can make mistakes. Check important details before you rely on them.

The internet is an ad. We aren't.

Shopping online means drowning in choices, second-guessing every review, and never knowing if you paid the right price. Flash is the store that fixes this.

Flash is a shopping app run entirely by AI agents. Six agents research 1M+ products across millions of reviews and videos, so every list and every recommendation is honest, unbiased and transparent. Nothing changes what they conclude.

HOW FLASH WORKS

1. The Agents Find the Best Products
    They gather candidates from AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude), marketplaces and web search. Every category, every brand.
2. They Check Everything About Each One
    Every rating and review gets validated against Reddit, YouTube, experts and real buyers. For each product, the agents cross-check 100+ reviews, videos and expert opinions. Seeded reviews and guesses get thrown out. Each product earns one honest Flash Score, with real strengths and real limitations. If something is not worth your money, the score says so. We would rather lose a sale than lose your trust.
3. Only the Top 1% Gets In
    The other 99% get rejected. What is left is the short list worth your time.
4. At the Best Price
    Prices scanned live across 15,000+ stores, refreshed on every check, so you never overpay.

HOW YOU CAN USE FLASH

Search and browse

Ask
 Will that retinol work with your niacinamide? Which serum for oily skin under 800 rupees? Ask Flash AI in your own words and get a straight answer, with the products to back it.

Check

WHAT YOU CAN SHOP

Skincare, haircare, bath and body, fragrances and oral care. Smartphones, headphones, laptops, TVs and home appliances. Ingredient breakdowns, concern-based guides and spec-checked picks across every category.

WHY 10M+ SHOPPERS TRUST FLASH

→ 1M+ products checked
→ Millions of reviews and videos read
→ 15,000+ stores scanned for the best price
→ Shoppers across 100+ countries

About to buy something? Check Flash first.

** Featured on TechCrunch, Daring Fireball, iMore, 9to5Mac, BGR, MacRumors & more! **
Ask Petey a question from your Apple Watch and read the answer on your wrist. No phone needed, no waiting for a screen to light up. Petey runs as its own Watch app, with a complication for your watch face so an answer is one tap away.

Petey is also on iPhone and iPad, and your conversations stay in sync across all three.

ON YOUR WATCH
• Ask by voice or scribble, read the answer right there
• Scroll long answers with the Digital Crown
• Have the answer read out loud
• Send an answer to your phone to use it in another app
• Add Petey as a complication for one-tap access

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Full conversation history, synced with your Watch
• Live Activity while Petey is thinking, so you can keep doing other things
• Share a single answer or a whole conversation
• Open any link Petey mentions with one tap
• Create Apple Music playlists and view places in Apple Maps from a conversation
• Shortcuts: open Petey or ask it a question from a shortcut, or from Siri

USE YOUR OWN API KEY
If you have an OpenAI API key, add it in settings and Petey uses it directly. You pay OpenAI, not us, and you can pick from the models your key allows. A ChatGPT Plus subscription is not an API key; keys come from platform.openai.com.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Petey is free to use with a monthly limit of messages. Petey Premium removes the limit and unlocks the more capable models. Bought Petey before it went free? Tap Restore Purchases and your original purchase carries over.

PRIVACY
Conversations are stored on your device and in your iCloud. Petey does not sell or share your data.

record.description_evidence:
Welcome to Persimmon, the ultimate AI-assisted research exploration tool for iOS! In a world where scientific breakthroughs are accelerating faster than ever but many struggle to keep pace, Persimmon bridges the gap between cutting-edge research and everyday understanding. Designed for researchers, scientists, students, and anyone with a passion for discovery, the app transforms complex arXiv and SocArXiv paper abstracts into digestible, tailored insights using the language models of your choice. Whether you’re diving into machine learning, quantum computing, or macroeconomic trends, Persimmon makes research accessible, engaging, and available at your fingertips.  

Why Persimmon?  
The sheer volume of scientific research published today is staggering. Thousands of papers flood leading preprint servers like arXiv and SocArXiv each week, making it nearly impossible to stay informed without specialized knowledge. At the same time, scientific literacy is declining, with many people feeling disconnected from the innovations shaping our future. Persimmon tackles these challenges head-on by simplifying the process of exploring, understanding, and saving research papers – no PhD required!  

Key Features:  
- Customizable AI Summaries: Choose your preferred OpenAI-compatible language model (LLM) to generate summaries. Control costs and model preferences with your own API configurations.  
- Switch Between Providers: Seamlessly toggle between multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Mistral, DeepSeek, Claude, custom models) using secure, on-device saved settings.  
- Tailored to Your Level: Set your expertise level (beginner, intermediate, or expert) for each topic to receive summaries that match your understanding.  
- arXiv & SocArXiv Search Made Easy: Find papers instantly with full-text search across arXiv and SocArXiv. Filter by categories to discover what interests you.  
- Offline Access: Save your favorite papers to read without an internet connection.  
- Daily Updates: Never miss a breakthrough! Get automatic notifications for the latest arXiv and SocArXiv papers in your chosen fields.  
- Privacy First: Persimmon respects your privacy. There’s no data collection, tracking, or analytics.  
- Breezy Performance: Built entirely in SwiftUI with minimal dependencies, Persimmon is snappy, intuitive, and optimized for iOS.  
- AI-Optional: Prefer raw data? Use Persimmon as a no-frills preprint browser.

How It Works:  
1. Set Your Interests: Select arXiv/SocArXiv categories or topics that fascinate you.  
2. Choose Your AI Model: Configure your preferred LLM and expertise level to personalize summaries.  
3. Explore & Save: Dive into abstracts, search papers, or save key findings for offline access.

Every day our model scores player props across recent form, matchup, workload and role, park and weather, and lineup status. Each prop gets a DiamondEdge rating from 1 to 5 diamonds and a plain-English write-up of why it stands out, plus the risks to watch.

• Today's board: every prop our model scored, with last 5 and last 10 hit rates and game-by-game charts
• Top Picks: the day's highest-rated props, with the full AI analysis
• Trends: hot streaks, 8-of-10 hitters and cold spells
• Player pages: every prop for a player in one place
• Results: our Free Preview picks, graded in public after every game, misses included
• Saved research: save props and see how they graded

DIAMONDEDGE PRO
Pro unlocks every rating, Top Pick and AI write-up across every live sport, plus filters, player pages and unlimited saves. Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends, and the subscription renews for the same period (month or year) unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

RESEARCH ONLY
DiamondEdge is a research tool. It is not a sportsbook, it does not accept wagers, and it shows no odds. No outcome is guaranteed. You must be 21 or older. If gambling stops being fun, call 1-800-GAMBLER.

Pre-register now for early access, exclusively for our iOS community and UpRockers!

UpRock is home to 3M+ people earning rewards through fun, everyday activities. And living inside the app is Rocket, your always-on AI agent.

Say hi to Rocket! Think of Rocket as your loyal sidekick: eager, tireless, and always fetching. Ask for anything and Rocket goes and gets it from across the web, day or night, then rewards you for being part of the pack. You bring the ideas. Rocket does the running.

WHAT ROCKET DOES
Rocket is a full AI agent in one app. Ask it anything, and it works across the live web to get it done.
• Research and answers: deep web research, summaries, and reports from one chat
• Run tasks 24/7: Rocket keeps working while you sleep
• Watch and alert: monitor sites, prices, and topics, with proactive notifications
• Get organized: reminders, scheduling, and files, all in one place
• Connect your apps: works with the tools you already use

MULTIPLE WAYS TO EARN
• Rocket rewards you for everyday activities and for being part of the network.
• Play & Earn: discover new mobile games and earn rewards for every minute you play
• Paid Surveys: share your opinion and get rewarded
• Magic Receipts: turn shopping receipts into rewards. Scan and earn.
• Community Events: join weekly challenges, earn exclusive badges, complete fun tasks
• Rocket Boosts: temporary bonuses that increase how much you earn

YOUR WALLET, BUILT IN
• Track everything you earn in one place.
• UpRock Points (UPTP) accumulate in your in-app Wallet as you complete activities
• Earn staking rewards on your balance
• Turn rewards into cashout, deals, or Rocket Fuel credits
• Full control over your balance, managed directly in the app

THREE WAYS TO USE ROCKET
Swap your rewards for premium agent features, pay as you go, or subscribe. Affordable, multi-agent, and full-featured out of the box.

COMMUNITY & BADGES
Level up your profile. Complete quests to earn rare badges and unlock higher reward tiers.

PRIVACY YOU CONTROL
Your privacy comes first, and you stay in control.
• We do not sell your personal data or your history
• Rocket saves your work, history, and artifacts so you can revisit, rerun, and remix what it does for you
• App connectors are optional. Rocket only connects to outside apps when you turn them on, with clear permissions you manage
• Turn off or disconnect anything, anytime

SIMPLE & GLOBAL
All you need is an email, and Rocket starts working for you in under two minutes.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
How do I earn rewards?
Earn by playing games, taking surveys, scanning magic receipts, and joining community events. Rocket Boosts can increase how much you earn during a limited time.

How much can I earn?
Your earnings depend on your activity level. The more you play, scan, and join events, the more you can earn.

What are UpRock Points?
UpRock Points (UPTP) are in-app rewards you earn for completing activities like games, surveys, and promotions. They accumulate in your Wallet so you can track everything in one place.

What are Rocket Boosts?
Rocket Boosts are temporary bonuses that increase your earn rate. Earn them through activities, achievements, or promotions. They are optional, last a limited time, and expire automatically.

Is my data safe?
Yes. We do not sell your personal data or your history. Rocket saves your work and history so you can pick up where you left off, and you control it. Connecting outside apps is always optional, with clear permissions you manage.

Can I use this app worldwide?
Yes. UpRock is available globally.

How do I manage my rewards?
You have full control over your balance, managed directly in the app. For the latest updates, visit uprock.com.

How do I contact support?
Reach our support team through the contact options in the app.

Download UpRock, join the fun and put Rocket to work today!

Cheers,
The UpRock Team
